description: This file defines the ValidateMethodCondition class, which implements a conditional operation based on invoking a static validation method specified by class and method names. It is part of the MiniLang framework in the OFBiz project, enabling dynamic validation logic within mini-language definitions.

classes.name: ValidateMethodCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional check that invokes a static validation method on a specified class and method, using reflection to determine the outcome, and executes associated sub-operations based on the result.

classes.name: ValidateMethodConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ValidateMethodCondition for the 'if-validate-method' element.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Performs the reflection-based invocation of the specified static validation method, returning true if validation passes, false otherwise.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional logic, running sub-operations if the condition is true, or else sub-operations if false.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from nested sub-operations for analysis or documentation.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Produces a human-readable representation of the validation condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the element's key attributes.
